Class GameLoader

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.persistence.GameLoader
public class GameLoader extends Object
Utility class responsible for loading saved game files from disk. It can deserialize a full GameController object from a file and also clean up outdated save files. The class cannot be instantiated.

  • Method Details

    • loadGame

      public static GameController loadGame(File file)
      Loads a complete game from the given file and reconstructs the GameController object. It also re-initializes the flight board and associated player data.
      Parameters:
      file - the file containing the saved game data
      Returns:
      a reconstructed GameController instance
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an I/O error occurs during loading

    • findSavedGame

      public static Optional<GameController> findSavedGame(String gameName)
      Searches for a saved game file in the default save directory that matches the provided game name. Also checks and deletes outdated files during the search.
      Parameters:
      gameName - the name of the game to load
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the loaded GameController if found, otherwise empty

    • savedGamesWithPlayersName

      public static ArrayList<GameInfo> savedGamesWithPlayersName(String playerName)
      Retrieves a list of GameInfo objects representing saved games in which the specified player is present.

      This method scans the save directory defined by BASE_SAVE_PATH, checks each valid game file to see if it contains the given player's name, and constructs a GameInfo object for each matching file. Invalid or outdated save files may be deleted during the process via checkDataAndDelete(File).

      Parameters:
      playerName - the name of the player to search for in saved games
      Returns:
      a list of GameInfo objects corresponding to games the player is part of

    • playerIsInGame

      public static boolean playerIsInGame(File file, String playerName)
      Checks whether a specific player is listed in the game file. The method only inspects lines at specific positions: 6, 44, 82, and 120 (1-based index) where the players' info are saved.
      Parameters:
      file - the file containing game data
      playerName - the name of the player to search for
      Returns:
      true if the player is found in any of the specified lines; false otherwise
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the file

    • gameInfoFromFile

      public static GameInfo gameInfoFromFile(File file)
      Reconstructs a GameInfo object from a saved game file.

      This method reads the first two lines of the file to extract the game's name, mode, and maximum player count. The current player count is not inferred and is set to 0 because the game isn't loaded. The returned GameInfo object is marked as restarted.

      Parameters:
      file - the file containing the saved game data
      Returns:
      a GameInfo object built from the file contents
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if an I/O error occurs while reading the file
